an8.42:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato bhikkhave, uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.42:1.2: kathaṃ upavuttho ca bhikkhave, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro:
an8.42:1.4: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtesu hitānukampino viharanti.
an8.42:1.5: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu hitānukampī viharāmi.
an8.42:1.6: imipanāhaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi. uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatīti
an8.42:2.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an8.42:2.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an8.42:2.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an8.42:2.5: evaṃ upavuttho kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāroti.
an8.42:3.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtasattaratanānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreyya, seyyathīdaṃ:
an8.42:3.3: aṅgānaṃ magadhānaṃ kāsīnaṃ kosalānaṃ vajjīnaṃ mallānaṃ cetīnaṃ vaṅgānaṃ kurūnaṃ pañcālānaṃ macchānaṃ sūrasenānaṃ assakānaṃ avantīnaṃ gandhārānaṃ kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an8.42:3.5: kapaṇaṃ bhikkhave, mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.42:4.1: yānimāni bhikkhave, mānusakāni paññāsavassāni cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:4.4: tena saṃvaccharena pañcavassasatāni cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:4.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:4.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.42:4.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.42:5.1: yaṃ bhikkhave mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo;
an8.42:5.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:5.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya,
an8.42:5.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.42:5.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.42:6.1: yāni bhikkhave, mānusakāni dve vassasatāni yāmānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:6.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni dve vassasahassāni yāmānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:6.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya,
an8.42:6.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.42:6.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.42:7.1: yāni kho bhikkhave, mānusakāni cattāri vassasatāni tusitānaṃ eso eko rattindivo;
an8.42:7.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni cattāri vassasahassāni tusitānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:7.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:7.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.42:7.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.42:8.1: yāni bhikkhave, mānusakāni aṭṭhavassasatāni nimmāṇaratīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo.
an8.42:8.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni aṭṭhavassasahassāni nimmāṇaratīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:8.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā nimmāṇaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya,
an8.42:8.6: imaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.42:8.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an8.42:9.1: yāni bhikkhave, mānusakāni soḷasavassasatāni paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo;
an8.42:9.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni soḷasavassasahassāni paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ
an8.42:9.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā paranimmitasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya
an8.42:9.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an8.42:9.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāyāti.
an8.42:10.1: pāṇaṃ na hāne na ca dinnamādiye
an8.42:10.2: musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā
an8.42:11.1: mālaṃ na dhāre na ca gandhamācare
an8.42:12.1: cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā
an8.42:15.1: tasmāhi nārī ca naro ca sīlavā
